description: Create, update, or delete a buyer profile / ICP (feeds article targeting + entity triples). Create: title+industry+demographics. Update: profileId + changed fields. Delete: profileId + del=true.

buyingTriggers.description: What makes them start looking, one per item

demographics.description: Demographics object; required on create (same shape the dashboard saves)

objections.description: Why they hesitate to buy, one per item

painPoints.description: Problems the buyer wants solved, one per item

preferredChannels.description: Where they look for answers, like Google or Reddit, one per item

profileId.description: Buyer profile id from get_brand. Leave it out to create one.

title.description: Who the buyer is, like "Head of marketing at a SaaS company"

name: write_brand_icp
